script.narration: The Sun destroys Earth in seconds. Our star grows ten percent brighter. One billion years triggers extreme heat. Temperatures exceed one hundred degrees Celsius. Oceans boil at hundred degrees. Zero water remains on Earth. Five billion years drains core hydrogen. Gravity collapses the solar core. Helium fusion ignites intense heat. The Sun swells dramatically outward. It expands one hundred times larger. Mercury vaporizes in instant heat. Venus is the second victim. Powerful winds strip solar mass. Thirty percent mass is lost. Earth migrates to outer orbits. Tidal drag pulls Earth inward. Friction destroys the planet quickly. Vaporization takes only several weeks. Two possible fates await Earth. Only a frozen rock remains. One dead white dwarf rules.
